pairs.name: Equal weight vs cap weight S&P 500
pairs.reads: Rising: the average stock is beating the index (broad market). Falling: a few mega-caps are carrying it (narrow market).

pairs.name: Coca-Cola vs PepsiCo
pairs.reads: Rising: Coca-Cola is outperforming PepsiCo. Two staples with overlapping businesses (beverages), but PepsiCo also carries snacks (Frito-Lay), so snack-specific news moves the ratio too.

pairs.name: Chevron vs Exxon Mobil
pairs.reads: Rising: Chevron is outperforming Exxon. Both are integrated oil majors that track crude closely, so the ratio mostly reflects company-specific news (production, deals, refining margins).
